additional_sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_actions (
 character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 request_id TEXT NOT NULL, operation TEXT NOT NULL, payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 result_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(character_id,request_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_army_formation (
 character_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 hero_pos INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(hero_pos IN(2,3)),pawn_pos INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(pawn_pos IN(2,3)),
 sorted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(sorted IN(0,1)),CHECK(hero_pos!=pawn_pos))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_buildings (
 character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 son_type INTEGER NOT NULL, template_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 target_template INTEGER, finishes_at INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(character_id,son_type))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_campaign_results (
 battle_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 run_id TEXT NOT NULL,campaign_id INTEGER NOT NULL,node_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 won INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(won IN(0,1)),player_hp INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(player_hp>=0),
 enemies_json TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_campaign_runs (
 character_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>=0),state_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(state_json)<=262144))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_duels (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, challenger INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id),
 target INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id),
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN('invited','rejected','finished','expired')),
 expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, seed TEXT NOT NULL, result_json TEXT,
 created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK(challenger!=target))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_economy (
 character_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 settled_at INTEGER NOT NULL, remainder INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(remainder BETWEEN 0 AND 3599),
 hourly_rate INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(hourly_rate>=0),tax_day INTEGER NOT NULL,
 tax_used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(tax_used>=0))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_facts (
 character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 kind TEXT NOT NULL, subject INTEGER NOT NULL, amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount>=0),
 PRIMARY KEY(character_id,kind,subject))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_guild_applications (
 guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES game_guilds(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(guild_id,character_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_guild_members (
 character_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES game_guilds(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 rank TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(rank IN('leader','officer','member')),
 contribution INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, joined_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_guilds (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, name_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 leader_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id), creator_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id), level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
 bank INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(bank>=0), description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_items (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 template_id INTEGER NOT NULL, bag INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(bag IN(1,4,6)),
 position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(position>=0), count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(count>0),
 bound INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(bound IN(0,1)), UNIQUE(character_id,bag,position))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_pawn_audit (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id),
 operation TEXT NOT NULL,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_pawn_slots (
 character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 slot INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(slot IN(0,1)),son_type INTEGER NOT NULL,
 count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(count>0),PRIMARY KEY(character_id,slot),
 FOREIGN KEY(character_id,son_type) REFERENCES game_pawns(character_id,son_type))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_pawns (
 character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 son_type INTEGER NOT NULL, template_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 reserve INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(reserve>=0),PRIMARY KEY(character_id,son_type))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_progress (
 character_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 xp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(xp>=0), pending_xp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(pending_xp>=0),
 origin TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_quests (
 character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 quest_id INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN('accepted','claimed')),
 accepted_at INTEGER NOT NULL, claimed_at INTEGER, claims INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 period INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, baseline_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', PRIMARY KEY(character_id,quest_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_resources (
 character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(currency IN('honor','guild_offer','bound_diamonds','crystals','souls','strategy','glory','blank_pet_cards','stamina','score','maze_coin','mine_score','guild_pve','hero_xp')),
 amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647), PRIMARY KEY(character_id,currency))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_reward_events (
 character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 event_id TEXT NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(character_id,event_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_skill_preferences (
 character_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(enabled IN(0,1)),percent INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(percent BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
 normal_skill TEXT NOT NULL,special_skill TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_skills (
 character_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 learned_json TEXT NOT NULL,fast_keys TEXT NOT NULL,spent INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(spent>=0))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_wallet_log (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id),
 currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(currency IN('gold','diamonds')), delta INTEGER NOT NULL,
 before_amount INTEGER NOT NULL, after_amount INTEGER NOT NULL,
 reason TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_world (
 character_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 map_id INTEGER NOT NULL, x INTEGER NOT NULL, y INTEGER NOT NULL, moved_at REAL NOT NULL,
 move_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wartune_roles (
    character_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    sex INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sex IN (0,1)),
    icon INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (icon BETWEEN 1 AND 6),
    camp INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (camp = 1),
    site TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(site) BETWEEN 1 AND 64),
    CHECK ((sex = 1 AND icon BETWEEN 1 AND 3) OR (sex = 0 AND icon BETWEEN 4 AND 6))
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wartune_tickets (
    account_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    md5_key_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(md5_key_hash) = 64),
    session_token_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(token_hash) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    site TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(site) BETWEEN 1 AND 64),
    expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wartune_training (
                character_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision >= 0),
                state_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(state_json) <= 65536),
                updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wartune_training_events (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
                kind TEXT NOT NULL,
                state_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(state_json) <= 65536),
                created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(character_id, revision))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wartune_training_results (
                battle_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                node_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                won INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(won IN(0,1)),
                player_hp INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(player_hp BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647),
                enemy_hp_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_notifications (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,event_key TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL,message TEXT NOT NULL,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(character_id,event_key))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS game_notifications_owner ON game_notifications(character_id,id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_mail(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,sender_id INTEGER,subject TEXT NOT NULL,body TEXT NOT NULL,reward_json TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,read_at INTEGER,claimed_at INTEGER,deleted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,event_key TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(character_id,event_key))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_shop_purchases(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id),shop_id INTEGER NOT NULL,count INTEGER NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS game_shop_owner ON game_shop_purchases(character_id,shop_id,created_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_daily(character_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,last_day INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1,total_days INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,reward_bits INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_guild_meta(guild_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES game_guilds(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,placard TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',open_app INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_guild_invites(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES game_guilds(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,inviter_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id),created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(guild_id,character_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_chat(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,channel INTEGER NOT NULL,recipient_id INTEGER,scope TEXT NOT NULL,message TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_guild_upgrades(guild_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES game_guilds(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,target_level INTEGER NOT NULL,finishes_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_migrations(name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_resource_ledger(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id),currency TEXT NOT NULL,delta INTEGER NOT NULL,before_amount INTEGER NOT NULL,after_amount INTEGER NOT NULL,reason TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS game_chat_owner_time ON game_chat(character_id,created_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS game_mail_owner_deleted ON game_mail(character_id,deleted,id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS game_mail_sender_time ON game_mail(sender_id,created_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_campaign_sweeps(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,campaign_id INTEGER NOT NULL,state_json TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS game_sweeps_owner ON game_campaign_sweeps(character_id,created_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS game_sweeps_active ON game_campaign_sweeps(character_id) WHERE json_extract(state_json,'$.status')='running'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_vip(character_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,xp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(xp BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647),imported INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_vip_events(character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,event_id TEXT NOT NULL,amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount>=0),created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(character_id,event_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_vip_claims(character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,grade INTEGER NOT NULL,type INTEGER NOT NULL,period INTEGER NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(character_id,grade,type,period))

create table if not exists game_item_enhancements(item_id integer primary key references game_items(id) on delete cascade,character_id integer not null references characters(id) on delete cascade,grade integer not null check(grade>=0))

create table if not exists game_forge_stage(character_id integer not null references characters(id) on delete cascade,slot integer not null check(slot in(0,1)),item_id integer unique not null references game_items(id) on delete cascade,primary key(character_id,slot))

create table if not exists game_item_buffs(character_id integer not null references characters(id) on delete cascade,kind text not null,percent integer not null,expires_at integer not null,primary key(character_id,kind))

create table if not exists game_forge_actions(character_id integer not null references characters(id) on delete cascade,token text not null,item_id integer not null,from_grade integer not null,result_json text not null,primary key(character_id,token))

create table if not exists game_item_gems(item_id integer not null references game_items(id) on delete cascade,character_id integer not null references characters(id) on delete cascade,slot integer not null check(slot between 1 and 4),gem_template_id integer not null,bound integer not null check(bound in(0,1)),primary key(item_id,slot))

create table if not exists game_mounts(character_id integer not null references characters(id) on delete cascade,template_id integer not null,activated_at integer not null,expires_at integer not null,template_json text not null,primary key(character_id,template_id))

create table if not exists game_runes(character_id integer not null references characters(id) on delete cascade,rune_type integer not null,template_id integer not null,primary key(character_id,rune_type))

create table if not exists game_item_use_actions(character_id integer not null references characters(id) on delete cascade,token text not null,item_id integer not null,template_id integer not null,bag integer not null,pos integer not null,count integer not null,result_json text not null,primary key(character_id,token))

create table if not exists game_mount_state(character_id integer primary key references characters(id) on delete cascade,template_id integer not null check(template_id>0),mounted integer not null check(mounted in(0,1)),foreign key(character_id,template_id) references game_mounts(character_id,template_id))

create table if not exists game_gift_purchases(character_id integer not null references characters(id) on delete cascade,package_id integer not null,period text not null,count integer not null check(count>0),primary key(character_id,package_id,period))
create table if not exists game_fashion_state(character_id integer primary key references characters(id) on delete cascade,status text not null default '1,1,1,1')

create table if not exists game_craft_actions(character_id integer not null references characters(id) on delete cascade,token text not null,fingerprint text not null,result_json text not null,primary key(character_id,token))
create table if not exists game_fashion_progress(character_id integer primary key references characters(id) on delete cascade,grades integer not null default 1,gp integer not null default 0)
create table if not exists game_fashion_book(character_id integer not null references characters(id) on delete cascade,template_id integer not null,primary key(character_id,template_id))
create table if not exists game_fashion_looks(character_id integer primary key references characters(id) on delete cascade,looks_json text not null default '{}')

create table if not exists game_talent_progress(character_id integer primary key references characters(id) on delete cascade,grade integer not null default 0 check(grade>=0),spent integer not null default 0 check(spent>=0))

create table if not exists game_talent_skills(character_id integer not null references characters(id) on delete cascade,template_id integer not null,properties_json text not null,effects_json text not null,primary key(character_id,template_id))

create table if not exists game_fashion_appraisals(character_id integer not null references characters(id) on delete cascade,template_id integer not null,skill_id integer not null,properties_json text not null,primary key(character_id,template_id))
